map.因负载非恒定且含待机/其他回路，通用换算给理论值，以电表实测为准。: Because the load is not constant and includes standby and other circuits, the general conversion gives a theoretical value; trust the meter reading.
map.已知功率和时间算电量。: Compute the energy use from known power and time.

map.这个工具和功耗计算器区别？: How is this tool different from the power calculator?
map.：空调 1.5 kW 运行 4 h：E=6 kWh；若月电量 180 kWh 想: : an air conditioner of 1.5 kW running 4 h gives E=6 kWh; with a monthly use of 180 kWh the average daily runtime is t=180/(30*1.5)=4 h. Note: remember that part load and standby add up in reality.
